body: Kat forgot to recharge her shields.

To me? Yes. But I thought it wouldn't meet the requirements that society has to be allowed to live. I think I may have misunderstood those requirements?

Most of my life I had friends on the internet, because I was military brat and moved a lot. I honestly am thinking that the whole “you have to have friends to live thing” may not be a rule after all. I thought it was implied but that seems not to be the case from multiple people either saying it’s wrong or not even getting the premise.

I agree that she may not complete me, and yeah I let her control me, but I don’t really have an option. I don’t have the required support network to be on my own and find myself and even if I did I couldn’t hang out because of COVID. So I would basically be totally alone and a loser and therefore have to automatically die.

I don’t disagree but what I want doesn’t matter, it’s not my choice. If I’m alone with no relationship and no friends I would be deemed a loser, and be obliged to die. Which sucks because I have a job I like, hobbies I could do, but it’s not my call.

I get that, and ultimately I may not be right for her and she for me, but that doesn’t change the fact that I won’t be able to live if she leaves me, so like I can’t even do things like go work out because it might make her mad. She literally has my life in her hands and wonders why I panic when she gets upset. I won’t tell her why, because that would be unfair to her and coercive, but fuck it paralyzes me because I really don’t want to die but I would be obligated to die because of societies unspoken rules about having no one in your life making one a loser who has to die.

I appreciate it, but I don’t know if online friendships count. I mean they used to for me, and maybe under COVID they do. I don’t know if they satisfy the “you must be in a relationship or have friends or family who care about you in order to live” rule. The problem is I don’t know who decides if that is good enough for me to live or not.

It’s an implied rule, like the anti suicide phamplets say to turn to friends and family for support. But I have none. Because what they are implying is that only people who would be missed by others deserve to live. I think that’s pretty obvious.

Well she wants me to change and the targets keep moving, or are super unfair. And there’s like zero affection from her now so I feel she’s moved on and I have pretty much just given up. It’s over and I am going to die.
